title: CodeMap 3D
description: Interactive 3D map of your C# and TypeScript / JavaScript code: dependencies, architecture layers, DI lifetimes, call flows and sequence diagrams, one click away from the code.

title: Hunkly — Accept / Reject Git Changes Inline
description: Cursor-style inline review of what changed in the open file vs GitHub (upstream branch), HEAD or the index. Removed lines as red rows, added lines in green, mine / incoming / conflict classification, and Accept or Reject on every hunk with one click or one shortcut.

title: Papyrus Toolchain
description: Diagnostics, formatting and lints for Papyrus, the scripting language of Skyrim, Fallout 4 and Starfield

title: Rainbow XML
description: Colors XML tags in rainbow order by nesting depth (or by tag name), highlights matching tags, and marks unmatched ones.
